channel.title: Field Notes — The Sustainability Diet
channel.description: Short-form essays, fragments, and ideas running alongside The Sustainability Diet. Karen Pendergrass.

item.title: Seed dispersal and the evolutionary contract
item.description: When I eat fruit I still swallow the seeds. Their dispersal is unlikely. I half-ass honor my end of the evolutionary contract, nonetheless. A short essay drawn from a passage pulled from the Prologue of The Sustainability Diet, on megafaunal fruit syndrome, the seed-dispersal contract, and the fruits whose mouths went extinct.
